snippet.title: eCommerce '99 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Build your own e-Commerce empire in this first person business simulator. Create your own online store, add design elements, fulfil orders yourself or hire workers to do it for you. Purchase new warehouses and design their interior, hire marketing managers to run your ad campaigns, analysts to help you decide which product lines to expand into next or accountants to keep track of your businesses financial health. 

Interact with a deep customer simulation that allows you to create monopolies and push market prices to maximise profits. In other simulation games like Supermarket Simulator or TCG Card Store Simulator you are managing one store, while here you manage a company that will soon become a business empire. 

Although this is just the announcement trailer, the full release is planned for early 2026 so stay tuned.

Wishlists on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3952400/eCommerce_99/
